messages:
marco_si: Heads-up — LATAM SI cohort next month. Two quick things we keep hitting: (1) marketplace voucher SKUs map weirdly to local resellers, and (2) mentors want a lightweight shadow shift process so they can hand off to local consultants. Can we sketch a minimal playbook?

jess_ops: +1. Also seen customs delays where voucher->vendor flow expects an EIN/tax ID that local partner doesn't have. We should include a customs checklist and alternative shipping paths.

carmen_enable: I'm happy to draft a 1-page LATAM voucher appendix and a 30-min mentor shadow runbook. Prefer a one-pager with bullets, not a long doc.

devin_marketplace: I'll map voucher SKUs -> local marketplace offers and list known resellers per country (BR, MX, CL, AR). Will add notes about VAT and required docs.

si-bot: New task created: #PART-7121 "LATAM Voucher Appendix" assigned to devin_marketplace, due 2024-06-02.

marco_si: For shadowing: mentors want a 2-hour overlap window (30m sync, 90m co-support) and a short checklist to confirm access + run a smoke inference. If mentor can't join live, fallback is a recorded handoff with logs.

jess_ops: Re: customs, add these items: proforma invoice template, carrier contact template, and a 'local agent' fallback contact list. We'll need legal sign-off on the proforma.

carmen_enable: For mentor badge gate: propose a 'shadow-first' requirement where new mentors must complete 3 shadow shifts in-region and pass a 20-min practical (debug + voucher flow). That keeps it practical for partners who want badges.

devin_marketplace: On voucher mechanics — marketplace issues a token, vendor redeems it and ships. In LATAM some vendors require extra payment on delivery (taxes). I'll call out where vouchers do NOT cover tax/duties.

marco_si: Can we add a tiny validation script mentors can run on arrival to verify nodes and network? Helps avoid 30-60m wasted trying to repro. Example request: check kernel + nics + curl to registry.
jess_ops: please include MTU/firmware checks. We had one site where a jumbo MTU broke model downloads via S3 multi-part.

carmen_enable: I'll add the script to the shadow runbook and include exact copy mentors can paste into Slack to request partner confirm pre-flight. e.g.:

"""
Hi @partner-site, before we start the lab can you run: 
1) nvidia-smi
2) curl -fS https://my-assets.redwood/example-model.tar.gz -o /tmp/m.tar.gz
3) uname -r && cat /etc/os-release
Reply with outputs or paste into the sheet.
"""

devin_marketplace: Nice. I'll also produce a short SKU table in CSV: sku, local_offer_id, vendor, vat_note, customs_flag. Will attach to the doc.

si-bot: New task created: #PART-7125 "LATAM Mentor Shadow Runbook" assigned to carmen_enable, due 2024-05-30.

marco_si: Escalation path idea: time-critical hardware (failed nodes during cohort) -> mentor oncall (30m SLA) -> partner success (2h) -> eng-runtime (4h). We should document expected steps and who does what within the first 30m.
jess_ops: Add a 'first 15' triage checklist: confirm serial numbers, run validation script, capture logs, and attempt warm swap (if spare).

carmen_enable: For the badge, the practical exam can be run during a live session with a proctor. We'll formalize scoring (able to run script, read logs, escalate). Badges last 1 year.

devin_marketplace: One edge-case: reseller-only shipping. If partner uses reseller, voucher redemption path differs; we need a short annex describing alternate flows and a sample email for vendors to confirm voucher acceptance.

marco_si: Admin ask — can we have a shared sheet that tracks: cohort, mentor, shadow_count, voucher_code, vendor, customs_required, interop_passed. That will make reporting to sales easier.
jess_ops: I'll provision the sheet and add partner success and legal viewers. Make a column that flags 'requires local agent' so ops can loop in procurement early.
carmen_enable: I'll draft the one-page runbook + badge rubric and drop links in this thread when ready. Aim for draft by 2024-05-10.
devin_marketplace: I'll aim voucher mapping CSV + reseller annex by 2024-05-08.

si-bot: Meeting scheduled: LATAM SI onboarding prep 024-05-12 10:00 UTC. Invite sent to cohort leads.

marco_si: Thanks all. Quick decisions captured:
- Mentor shadow requirement: 3 shadows + 20-min practical for badge
- LATAM voucher appendix: call out taxes/duties & reseller flows
- Shadow overlap: 2 hours with 30m sync
- Validation script + 'first 15' triage checklist to avoid wasted cycles

jess_ops: confirmed, will start sheet and templates.

carmen_enable: confirmed, will post draft runbook in this thread.

devin_marketplace: confirmed and linking internal SKU list here once done.

si-bot: Thread closed: action items created and owners assigned.
